name: dcms
description: DCMS - Hệ thống quản lý Phiếu & Tác vụ theo quy trình

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,kb -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w knowledge"
scripts.start: npm run build -w web && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w knowledge
